issues.description: mathdecl.py registers exp2 by mutating Math_unary, breaking the class indentation/structure
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block is placed immediately after Math_unary's class body with no blank line, and rebinds `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)`. This conflates a decorator-style registration with name rebinding. It works but is fragile: any later code referring to Math_unary now points to the result of infer_global, and it visually breaks the class definition. Prefer `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` without rebinding, or a separate registration call.

issues.description: Missing newline at end of release note file
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a trailing newline (`\ No newline at end of file`). Many projects' lint/towncrier checks require trailing newlines on RST fragments. Add a final newline.

issues.description: Docs entry does not note Python 3.11+ requirement
issues.detail: Both the pysupported.rst entry and the upcoming_changes note list math.exp2 as supported without mentioning that it is only available on Python 3.11+. Users on older Pythons will be confused when the function is missing. Add a parenthetical note like `(requires Python 3.11+)`.

issues.description: `sys` import added to mathimpl.py files but not shown — verify it exists
issues.detail: The diff in `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` references `sys.version_info` but does not show an `import sys` being added. If `sys` is not already imported in those modules, this will NameError at import time on all Python versions. Confirm the import exists in both files.

issues.description: Test x_values do not exercise interesting exp2 inputs
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is copied from test_exp and contains a duplicated -2 and 2. exp2 has notable inputs worth testing (0 -> 1, integer powers, large negatives toward 0, fractional like 0.5 -> sqrt(2)). Consider distinct, exp2-meaningful values.

issues.description: Use of PYVERSION vs sys.version_info is inconsistent across files
issues.detail: The test uses `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` from numba.core.utils, while the typing and impl files use `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`. Numba conventionally guards Python-version-specific code with `PYVERSION` everywhere for consistency and easier grepping. Align both impl files to use PYVERSION.

review.summary: The PR adds math.exp2 support via LLVM's exp2 intrinsic with appropriate Python 3.11+ guards and a focused test. Main concerns: the registration of Math_unary for exp2 rebinds the class name in a way that visually disrupts the class definition and is fragile; sys imports may be missing from the impl files; version gating uses a mix of sys.version_info and PYVERSION inconsistently; the release note lacks a trailing newline and neither docs entry mentions the 3.11+ requirement. Test inputs are duplicated from test_exp without exercising exp2-specific values.
